text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of a party hosted by 
Tracen Academy. Rather than an internal 
event, it was geared towards external 
guests like media and sponsoring 
companies—
—And among them was Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh, so you showed up too.
choice_data_list: I had some helper duties. What about you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, some distinguished VIPs 
specifically requested me. Well, 
entertainin' them for a bit ain't bad 
either, is it?

Thinking that sounded just like her, we 
chatted for a bit. Meanwhile, the party 
officially began.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
To grace our grand opening, a ballroom 
dance by the "Emperor", Symboli Rudolf!

Welcomed by thunderous applause, Symboli 
Rudolf appeared in the center of the hall 
with her partner. They began to dance 
gracefully along with the music.

The sound of their paired steps echoed 
through the venue. While the audience was 
entranced by the dazzling spectacle, 
Sirius Symboli alone wore a grim 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
............She's not into it. Boring. 
Just her usual honor student facade.

Was she talking about... Symboli Rudolf? 
It looked like an outstanding dance to me, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hey, do you know the "Emperor"'s motto?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Take it easy." 'Let's take it easy', she 
says.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everything comes easy to that girl. 
She oughta be able to 'freely' choose 
whatever she wants.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And yet... she doesn't even understand the 
value of that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—There are plenty of reasons why a horse 
girl might end up walking away from 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Injuries, poor results, physical or mental 
burnout, family issues, or just lacking 
the aptitude to begin with...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Normal folks carry all those burdens. They 
never get to be truly 'free'.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In that sense— She was special right from 
the start.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
She had everything. She held the 'freedom' 
that anyone would kill for. And even so...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...She threw that 'freedom' away with her 
own hands.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Bound by notions of 'how things ought to 
be', walking down a damn boring path. 
...Tch.

She gazed at the center of the venue with 
sharp, severe eyes. Surely, she was seeing 
a scene that only she could perceive.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: This is getting dull. I'm heading out.
choice_data_list:
Wait, weren't you scheduled to dance 
too...?

Wait, weren't you scheduled to dance 
too...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter. As long as the "Emperor" 
is here, everyone seems well satisfied 
anyway—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No, wait— If it's boring, I'll just make 
it interesting.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That way, I can smash up this whole damn 
venue... Kuku, haha! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's settled. You, give me your 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're not just some doll that fawns over 
the "Emperor", are you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Then you're my partner for tonight. 
...Don't go embarrassing me, got it?

Suddenly pulled along by her, I was tossed 
into the center of the hall. Led without 
knowing what was happening, I scrambled to 
match her steps.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Come on, spin! —That's it, keep stepping 
just like that!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Did you see that? The stunned look 
on those spectators' faces. That was pure 
gold!
choice_data_list: That was bad for my heart...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Still, it was a valuable experience for 
you. ...Hope you don't get hooked on it, 
though.

She suggested catching some fresh air 
outside, so we ended up on a hill 
overlooking the party hall from earlier.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Look at that. Pretty tiny box, isn't it? I 
have no intention of staying in a place 
like that forever.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll smash the royal road to pieces and 
walk the thorny path. And then—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —someday, I'll reach that place.

She pointed up toward a first-magnitude 
star, shining with exceptional brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sirius is the brightest star of all. 
Shining over everyone's heads. Someday, 
everyone will be looking up to it.

The star seemed to flash like the fangs of 
a wolf. —Sharp, ferocious, and insatiable.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Look at you, you can do it if you 
try!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That was worth full marks back there. If 
you want more praise, keep putting in the 
effort, alright?

Flashing an amused smile, Sirius Symboli 
walked away. At any rate, I'm glad it 
ended without incident...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, might I have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You were dancing with Sirius earlier, were 
you not? Though it was not on the program, 
it stirred up even more excitement than 
anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am truly grateful. Both to you, and to 
Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Including what happened today, I 
owe her a great deal of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Her mindset is entirely unbound. Because 
she is not constrained by molds, she 
captivates those who watch her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not just today's audience, but the 
students as well. Many are drawn to her 
side.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps there isn't just one. The shining 
star of hope sought by those facing 
turbulent paths—
